title: Composition-invariant strain engineering of metal sulfides for efficient hydrogen evolution
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE01630H, Paper
Hongfang Du, Ke Wang, Song He, Boxin Li, Wei Ai
A molten-salt-mediated quenching strategy is reported for composition-invariant tuning of lattice strain in transition-metal sulfides. RuS2 catalysts with tunable tensile strain are synthesized to investigate the strain and HER activity relationship.
